description: 250 documents (pages of 100, 100, 50: loop ends on the short page) and 200 files (pages of 100, 100, then an empty page 3 ends the loop). Items alternate the id/document_id/file_id and name/file_name, size/size_bytes keys and omit optional fields, so every fallback default in the mapping is pinned; extra upstream fields are dropped.
